blocks.html: The Sinulog festival is one of the most famous festivals on the Philippine calendar attracting millions of visitors each year. As the festival is renowned for its electrifying parade and grandeur, Robinsons Galleria Cebu is making sure that its January schedule is a reason to celebrate for Cebuanos and tourists alike!

To add spice to the festivities, on January 18, Robinsons Land Ambassador Maja Salvador will heat up the stage and captivate the audience with her fiery dance moves and unmistakable stage presence. The Killer Bride star will leave you stunned with her energetic and sizzling production. Prepare to be astounded by her jaw-dropping performances!

Sinulog is firstly a religious festival in honor of Santo Niño and as technology moves forward, so does the opportunity to spread the Good News further. There will be several live streams of the masses for those who cannot go to church personally. First mass will start at 5:30 AM and the last mass is scheduled at 7:00 PM.

And to ease the Sinulog traffic during this season, Robinsons Galleria Cebu has partnered with the City Government and Sinulog Governing Board for free bus rides for the devotees. The route is from Robinsons Galleria Cebu to Malacañang sa Sugbo and vice versa. First trip will start at 9:30 AM and will end at 8:00 PM.

This is also the best time to feature exciting activities that cater everyone from all walks of life: January 11 – Little Ms. Sinulog Festival Queen Costume Display, January 12 – Little Ms. Sinulog Festival Queen, January 14 – Festival Queen Runway Competition, January 19 – Sinulog Concert, February 2 – Sinulog Photo and Short Film Awarding.

Watch out for activities happening all week long that you surely don’t want to miss: January 12 to January 19 – Sinulog SALE, January 13 to January 18 – Andas Exhibit, January 13 to January 17- Sinulog Dances at 5:00 PM, January 13 to January 31 – Artesano Pop-up Store, February 2 to February 15 – Sinulog Photo Exhibit.

Truly, Robinsons Galleria Cebu ups the excitement by filling the entire month with worthwhile events and activities that are sure to delight mall-goers well before and after Sinulog fever is at an all-time high.
